# M2c C/C++ fixtures

Synthetic, manually derived from the fully inspected Python CppStrategy and
catalog summary/manifest builders; not generated by executing Python. The TSV
records start line, kind, name and signature. No real repository data is included.

Catalog symbols intentionally omit structural end lines, as existing lane APIs
do. Includes/namespace/evidence exports/doc hints/companion paths are not consumed
by either catalog builder: imports remain generic Python import statements,
purpose uses the filename, and terms use the generic path/symbol contract.

The parent has integrated `pub mod cpp` and all ten case-insensitive C/C++ suffixes
with generic fallback on empty results. Joined offline validation is green;
STATUS.md records 169 distinct tests / 332 executions. The IntelliJ C/C++ lane
is empty and supplies no real-reference coverage.
